messages:
rachel_finance: Quick follow-up from the AH finance segment — can we unpack what you meant by 'constrain discretionary spend' for procurement planning?
sam_ceo: Short version: focus on customer-impacting work, safety/compliance, and revenue-driving ops. Hold or delay projects that are 'nice-to-have' this quarter. :white_check_mark:
maria_fp&a: Formalizing: planning baseline is 18 months of runway. If a team wants to assume a tighter 12-month runway, escalate to FP&A with tradeoffs.
finance-bot: [automated] Procurement thresholds: < $10k = manager sign-off; $10k–$75k = manager + finance; > $75k = exec + legal review.
jordan_eng: Does the $75k threshold include multi-month reserved infra commits (e.g., Dedicated GPU pools)?
maria_fp&a: Yes. Multi-month reserved commitments count toward the contract value. If a request crosses the $75k line, do a pre-review with FP&A before engaging procurement.
rachel_finance: Are there expedited paths for security/compliance spends (pen tests, SOC2 scoping, certs)? Some teams have deadlines.
nina_ops: Yes — security/compliance have a fast-track checkbox in the request form. Ping @nina_ops and I9ll triage within 48 hours. Add a short business impact blurb.
sam_ceo: Also: loop procurement in early for vendor negotiations. We have negotiation playbooks and templates that often get discounts or credits (e.g., month credits on year commits).
rachel_finance: For hiring: should managers pause all new IC reqs, or are backfills allowed?
sam_ceo: Backfills for revenue, reliability, customer-impacting roles are allowed. New headcount or expansion requests need a secondary review with FP&A. Keep hiring conservative. :chart_with_downwards_trend:
maria_fp&a: Action item: every team submit a 1-paragraph justification for active procurements and open hires by EOD next Friday. Prioritization rule: items with clear ROI or safety/compliance rationale will be advanced.
jordan_eng: Can FP&A share a one-page checklist for that justification so reviews are quicker?
maria_fp&a: Yes — I9ll post a template in the procurement doc and tag managers when live.
rachel_finance: Any guidance on pre-pay discounts or vendor credits?
sam_ceo: Include scenario analysis for pre-pay (6/12/18 months) showing impact on monthly burn. If pre-pay materially improves unit economics, include it; otherwise default to shorter commitments.
nina_ops: Ops will run a quick burn-impact spreadsheet for any pre-pay > $25k to show monthly cashflow implications.
finance-bot: [automated] Procurement docs: https://confluence.redwood.example/procurement-guidelines 
rachel_finance: One last ask — is there a fast lane for urgent infra renewals that would otherwise degrade customer SLAs?
maria_fp&a: Yes. Tag requests as "URGENT-SLA" and include the customer impact statement. FP&A + Ops will do a 48h turnaround for those.
rachel_finance: Thanks all — I9ll collect questions and the 1-paragraph template once Maria posts it. :thumbsup:
